request.initial_prompt: He did not say another word to Pétya but rode in silence all the way. When they had come to the edge of the forest it was noticeably growing light over the field. Denísov talked in whispers with the esaul and the Cossacks rode past Pétya and Denísov. When they had all ridden by, Denísov touched his horse and rode down the hill. Slipping onto their haunches and sliding, the horses descended with their riders into the ravine. Pétya rode beside Denísov, the pulsation of his body constantly increasing. It was getting lighter and lighter, but the mist still hid distant objects. Having reached the valley, Denísov looked back and nodded to a Cossack beside him.

raw_segments.text: He did not say another word to Pétya but rode in silence all the way.
When they had come to the edge of the forest it was noticeably growing light over the field.
Denísov talked in whispers with the esaul and the Cossacks rode past Pétya and Denísov.
When they had all ridden by, Denísov touched his horse and rode down the hill.
Slipping onto their haunches and sliding, the horses descended with their riders into the ravine.
Pétya rode beside Denísov, the pulsation of his body constantly increasing.
It was getting lighter and lighter, but the mist still hid distant objects.
Having reached the valley, Denísov looked back and nodded to a Cossack beside him.
